newsitem.title: USA: PNC to pay 15.16 pct premium for balance.
newsitem.headline: PNC to pay 15.16 pct premium for balance.

text.p: PNC Bank Corp said on Monday that it has purchased the credit card portfolios of 50 American Automobile Association (AAA) clubs from Mellon Bank Corp. More than 1.3 million AAA credit card accounts with an outstanding balance of $771 million were purchased at a premium of 15.16 percent.

AAA, a federation of 91 U.S. clubs providing travel, insurance, financial and auto-related services, selected PNC earlier this year to deliver a broad range of financial services to 35 million members nationwide.

"The acquisition of these existing AAA club member credit card accounts is another important step in the development of our exclusive relationship with AAA," said Thomas H. O'Brien, PNC chairman and chief executive officer.
The acquisition of the Mellon portfolio will involve no immediate changes for AAA credit card holders whose accounts have been acquired.
PNC, headquartered in Pittsburgh, is a financial services organizations with banking subsidiaries in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana, Massachusetts and Florida.
